profile.name: 电压表校准系统
profile.description: 用于实验室中对待测设备电压测量通道进行校准与核查的校准系统。该系统通常配合可编程电源、数字万用表和待校准设备使用，通过多个校准点与检查点完成电压表或模数转换读数的校准、平均测量和结果验证。
profile.description_en: A laboratory calibration system used to calibrate and verify the voltage measurement channel of a device under test. It is typically used together with a programmable power supply, a digital multimeter, and the DUT, applying multiple calibration and check points to calibrate a voltage meter or ADC-based reading, perform averaged measurements, and verify the result.

registry.name: Instrument Calibration
registry.description: Instrument Calibration Module是一款表征设备，主要功能包括校准、测量、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, check voltage calibration等操作。
